left: Use case: precise-object-edit / reusable game environment. Reference image 1 is the existing SECOND-floor left stair portal (retain its warm gold lighting, tall arched architecture and dark black framing). Reference image 2 is the FIRST-floor stairwell STYLE / railing-integration example only. Create ONE NEW high-resolution COMPLETE second-floor stairwell cutout, including golden steps, the attached railing/handrail with straight vertical balusters, warm golden arched masonry interior, dark receding arch opening, a hanging glowing bulb, full near-black structural frame, intact cap and plinth. For this LEFT stairwell the steps and diagonal attached handrail must rise from lower LEFT to upper RIGHT; keep that orientation. The railing MUST be painted coherently INSIDE the stairwell as part of this ONE illustration, fixed in the same perspective as the stairs, like the first-floor reference. No detached fence / floating railing layer, no high exterior rail crossing the corridor. Portrait front/side-view 2D cartoon painted game architecture, crisp detailed high-resolution contours, slender overall proportions around 1:2 width to height. Keep entire frame, column feet and lowest step fully visible, no holes at bottom. Background OUTSIDE the framed stairwell must be real transparent alpha. Everything inside the portal behind the railing is painted opaque masonry, stairs or dark doorway. No characters, NPC, floor sign, room number, letters, wall outside, purple sky, extra props or checkerboard. Small transparent border. This will be one background sprite drawn BEHIND the walking character, not a foreground occluder.
